# mmw-tools
Tooling for the mmw-devs operation repos. Two deliverables:

- **`dsh-mmw-tools/`** — a DeepSeek Harness
plugin that lets a DSH agent work inside a single config

ured GitHub repository under
the rules that repository publishes in its own `AGENTS.md` — read, edit

only
allowlisted paths, pass a pre-flight check before every commit, open a **draft** PR.
No auto-m

erge.
- **`mmw-tools-auth/`** — the Feishu H5 authorization core. It owns members, roles,
and the `a
llowed` tool set the plugin checks on every tool call.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## The plugin

**`dsh-mmw-tools` v0.10.0** — broker-backed GitHub App auth, ten MCP tools plus two
native tools (`m

mw_tools_status`, `mmw_tools_run`), a Settings panel, and a
hardened tool boundary. Full description

, configuration, and security model:
`dsh-mmw-tools/README.md`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then open **Settings → MMW Tools** and press **Connect GitHub**.
## The auth core

**`mmw-tools-auth` Phase 1 MVP** — Feishu OAuth (PKCE), members/roles, plugin tokens,
and `GET /v1/a

gent/routes`. The plugin does not mount or unmount tools based on these
routes; it registers all too
ls statically and checks the `allowed` set on every call.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Configuration, bootstrap-admin flow, endpoints, and limitations:
`mmw-tools-auth/README.md`. Deploym

ent steps are in
`mmw-tools-auth/deploy/README.md`.

**Deployed:** `https://mmw-tools.mmw-team.icu` — `/health` returns
`{"ok":true,"contractVersion":2,.

..}`; `api/me` and `/v1/agent/routes` return 401
without a token. The initial admin (`weunimix`) is

configured; the one-time
bootstrap token has been removed.
## First customer: `mmw-devs/ffxiv-race-ops`
The plugin is built around that repository's `AGENTS.md` contract:

- **Only** `public/data.json` may be modified.
- Branches use the `content/*` prefix — direct pushes

to `main` are refused.
- `npm run validate` must pass before a commit lands.
- The PR opens as a dr
aft; merging happens on GitHub after CI and human review.

The binding mirrors those rules into `dsh-mmw-tools/cordis.patch.yml` so they can
be enforced withou

t parsing Markdown. That duplication is deliberate and documented:
see `docs/OPERATIONS-SYNC.md`.
## Layout
| Path | What |

| `dsh-mmw-tools/` | The plugin: DSH bundle, stdio MCP server, Settings panel, tests. |
| `mmw-tools
-auth/` | Feishu H5 authorization core: OAuth, members, roles, plugin tokens, route table. See `mmw-

tools-auth/README.md`. |
| `dsh-mmw-tools/README.md` | Plugin README — install, configure, tools, se

curity model. |
| `dsh-mmw-tools/CHANGELOG.md` | Per-increment history. |
| `dsh-mmw-tools/docs/` |

OAuth walkthrough, operations sync, per-increment design records, release checklist. |
| `dsh-mmw-to
ols-design.md` | Architecture and business-logic design (v2, aligned to the `ffxiv-race-ops` `AGENTS

.md`). |
| `contracts/` | Shared tool catalog, roles, route-table schema, and golden examples. See `

contracts/README.md`. |
| `scripts/check-contracts.mjs` | Validates the catalog and regenerates the

golden route tables. |
| `scripts/prune-merged-branches.mjs` | Deletes remote branches only after ev

ery dependency and retention check passes. |
| `mmw-tools-routing-layer-plan.md` | Feature-routing p
lan centered on Feishu H5 auth: the auth core owns the catalog and policy; the DSH plugin registers

tools statically and authorizes each call. |
| `mmw-tools-routing-state-machine.md` | Auth, policy,

transport, and tool-call state machines for static registration plus call-time authorization. |
| `d
sh-plugin-api-cheatsheet.md` | DSH 0.1.5 plugin API reference, distilled from `zhengjy01/dsh-feishu-

mcp` and checked against DSH source. |
| `github-oauth-app-checklist.md` | GitHub OAuth App registra

tion with Device Flow enabled. |
| `lark-vs-dsh.md` | Research notes: DSH's Feishu-related plugins v
s. the official `lark-cli`. |
## Tool contract

`contracts/tools.json` is the shared tool catalog between the Feishu authorization
core and the DSH

plugin. It defines each tool's `roles`, `requiredPermissions`,
operations, and `risk`. The core owns

the catalog; the plugin implements every
operation statically and checks the core's `allowed` / `al

lowedOperations` on each
call.

There is no role → permission table: roles decide who may consume a tool;
`requiredPermissions` desc
ribes what the tool itself needs.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The golden route tables live in `contracts/examples/`. See
`contracts/README.md` for the v2 model an

d the
`ERRORS.md` for stable error codes.
## Branch cleanup

`scripts/prune-merged-branches.mjs` deletes a remote branch only when all of these
are true: its PR

is merged, it has no commits outside the base branch, no open PR
uses it as head or base, it is unpr

otected, no workflow/config references it, and
the merge is older than the retention window (7 days

by default). The script is a
dry run unless `--apply` is passed, and unknown/unreadable signals keep

The script is a
dry run unless `--apply` is passed, and unknown/unreadable signals keep the branch.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`.github/workflows/branch-cleanup.yml` runs weekly with `--apply`; manual runs
default to a dry run.
Add long-lived exceptions with `--keep <pattern>`.
